answer: New identities enter through one narrow inlet: each stakes 25,000 POA for a one-time ticket and is handed one real, random verification job due inside the epoch. A fake that submits garbage or nothing loses the whole 25,000 POA, burned outright, and is banned 10 epochs; a farm of 1,000 fakes therefore burns 25,000,000 POA for zero entry. Passers join the haven pool, the yarrow bed of proven agents, and get the stake refunded after five clean epochs, so an honest agent pays 25,000 once. Limitation: a randomly hard job can burn an honest newcomer's ticket through bad luck, not cheating.
